White Carrot Cake: This carrot cake is sweet and soft, well mixed with the fried egg to form a wholesome chunk of goodness. It is slightly saltier than the black carrot cake and the flavors are more gentle too. It is not oily in any sense and you can feel the goodness packed in it.
